title: Mars IAU Body-Fixed Frame
negative_results: areoid (Mars) height into ellipsoid Cartesian math is refused without a declared separation model
geoid (Earth) height into ellipsoid Cartesian math is refused without a declared separation model
a BodyModel with no declared IAU/geodetic convention is refused (invariant 7)
a body whose polar radius exceeds its equatorial radius is refused

claims.statement: Mars uses a declared IAU body-fixed convention (equatorial radius a=3396190 m, polar radius b=3376200 m, planetographic latitude, Airy-0 prime meridian).
The geodetic <-> body-fixed Cartesian transform round-trips exactly within its declared quantization for both Earth and Mars.
The areoid is an equipotential vertical datum, not the reference ellipsoid; the height convention is declared and never assumed.
No frame conversion asserts that any source-reported vector identifies a real location.
